assessment.basis: The energy-volume observations remain plot-only after source exhaustion. Table III independently prints V100=33.98 A3/FeSiO3, K100=579 GPa, and K100'=3.47; the Table I lattice product gives 33.9343 A3/FeSiO3.

scientific_validation.note: Retained after source-exhaustion review: the final Table III parameterization passes independent 100 GPa EOS and structure checks, but no authoritative E(V) rows were deposited and the record remains not refittable.

primary_source_check.finding: The final paper reports a separate static Vinet fit and complete 100 GPa structure for FeSiO3 PPv. APS, UCL, Carnegie, Crossref/OpenAlex relations, both arXiv versions, and research-data indexes expose no numerical E(V) supplement.

primary_data_check.finding: The energy-volume observations remain plot-only after source exhaustion. Table III independently prints V100=33.98 A3/FeSiO3, K100=579 GPa, and K100'=3.47; the Table I lattice product gives 33.9343 A3/FeSiO3.

independent_refit.method: Direct evaluation and inversion of the published Vinet coefficients at 100 GPa.
independent_refit.finding: V100 and K100' agree at printed precision; K100 differs by 1.13 GPa (0.20%) because final Table III rounds K0 to an integer. This is an equation-convention replay, not a row-level refit.

version_history_check.finding: Using v1 K0=189.7 GPa yields K100=578.726 GPa, confirming that final-publication integer rounding explains the apparent checkpoint offset; the version of record remains normative.

approximate_plot_diagnostic.finding: The x-axis-only marker reading agrees within 0.055 A3/FeSiO3; raster coordinates are not registered as a fit dataset.

inspected: APS version-of-record page and attachment inventory
UCL Discovery record and its single PDF
arXiv v1 PDF and v2 source archive
source_exhaustion.finding: The v2 archive contains TeX, BibTeX output, and eight EPS figures only; Figure 3 is a single encoded raster, not recoverable vector data.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Calculated states/theory determine this EOS; source: Table I; Computational methods; Figure 3; Table III; arXiv v1 Table 2; arXiv v2 source archive.
parameter_provenance.equation: Table III: Vinet EOS fitted to static E(V) data.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table III: 44.90 A3 per FeSiO3, multiplied by Z=4 to 179.6 A3.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: No coefficient uncertainties or covariance are published.
parameter_provenance.method: Quantum ESPRESSO PAW-PBE GGA+U, U=6.0 eV, 20-atom cell, 4x4x4 k mesh, 80 Ry cutoff; high-spin antiferromagnetic state.

superseded_record_text.notes: Retain as a directly published Vinet parameterization. Keep not_refittable: no numerical E(V) grid was deposited, and the approximate raster-marker diagnostic must not be treated as primary observations.
validity_notes: Static 0 K GGA+U curve, not an experimental stability field.
The source energy grid corresponds to -10 through 150 GPa at eight specified pressures.
